question.text: Every PM shall keep records of investment decisions along with:

answer.text: Data, facts, and opinion leading to the investment decision

explanation.text: The Logic: Records must indicate the rationale — data, facts, opinions — per SEBI. The Trap: Final portfolios without rationale are insufficient. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use structured investment-committee notes; they serve as audit trail and learning log.
